intro: Afghanistan is a landlocked, mountainous country, with the Hindu Kush running through its centre.

chapters.title: The Hindu Kush
text: The Hindu Kush covers much of the country; Noshaq, at 7,492 m, is the highest peak. The Wakhan Corridor is a narrow strip in the north-east that reaches China.
Deserts cover the south and south-west, and fertile plains lie in the north.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Winters are cold and snowy in the mountains, summers hot and dry. Droughts and earthquakes often hit the country.

keyTerms.meaning: A narrow finger of Afghan land between Tajikistan and Pakistan.
